{{Quote|Youth nowadays care little for wisdom, they are all so busy grasping for power.|Ha'zel|<ref name="SWG:RtAoIC" />}}
'''Ha'zel''' was a sage of the [[Singing Mountain Clan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] that lived at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She could often be found in a large room in the [[Singing Mountain Clan Fortress|Singing Mountain Clan Stronghold]] where the ceiling was covered with a bright image of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SWG:RtAoIC" />

Ha'zel used to maintain several old shrines created long ago by witches of the past. However as she got older, she lost the strength to travel the wilds and tend to the altars herself. So when a young [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] arrived at the clan's stronghold and gained favor with the clan mother, Ha'zel asked them for help to ensure that the shrines weren't lost to time. The spacer agreed to help her and repaired the [[Altar of inner calm]], [[Altar of dominance]], [[Altar of wisdom]] and [[Altar of power]]. When the spacer returned, Ha'zel thanked them and rewarded them with [[Allya's Holocron]].<ref name="SWG:RtAoIC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ha'zel was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RtAoIC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Sage Ha'zel was added to the game with the release of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Witches of Dathomir Theme Park|Witches of Dathomir Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:RtAoIC" /> introduced in the [[W:c:swg:Game Update 19|Game Update 19]] on [[December 14]], [[2010]].<ref name="GU19">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1160720|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 19}}</ref> She asked players of the [[:w:c:swg:Trader|Trader profession]] to repair several altars for her.<ref name="SWG:RtAoIC" />
